messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: redwood-inference-api v2.20 -> v2.21 and rewriter-service v1.8 -> v1.9, canary=3% regions=us-east,eu-west. Note: dependent services included. Release notes: https://internal/release/2.21 :rocket:
jess: Heads up — change-window today 22:30-23:00 UTC. tagging ops_manager for cross-service watch.
tom: quick metric peek: rewriter-service p50 stable but p99 jump in eu-west at +5m. Noticed batching backlog in rewriter.
arun: Hmm rewriter backlog could cascade to inference. Are we isolating rewriter canary from inference? Current plan is joint canary.
maya: We can decouple: keep inference at 3% but revert rewriter to v1.8 in eu-west while we triage. Anyone can execute regional decouple?
jess: I can run it. Will also set rewriter concurrency lower to avoid new backlog.
jess: Running commands now:
```
# region pin rewriter-service eu-west -> v1.8 and throttle
deployctl rollout region-pin --service rewriter-service --region eu-west --version v1.8 --reason "batch backlog" --now
deployctl config set --service rewriter-service --region eu-west --max_concurrency 20
```
deploy-bot: Action started: region-pin (rewriter-service eu-west) by jess at 1840007789.
deploy-bot: Config updated: rewriter-service eu-west max_concurrency=20.
tom: After pin, rewriter p99 dropped ~70% in eu-west, inference tail latency stabilized. Good signal.
arun: Recommend we hold rewriter progression globally until backlog root cause is identified, but let inference continue if stable.
ops_manager: Agreed. Proposal: pause rewriter canary increments and mark v1.9 blocked in eu-west. Also create incident for rewriter team.
jess: deploy-bot, pause automated increments for rewriter-service.
deploy-bot: Automated canary increments paused for rewriter-service at 1840007805 by system (requested by jess). Current state: inference 3% global, rewriter eu-west pinned to v1.8.
maya: For audit record: regional rollback command for rewriter eu-west: `deployctl rollback --service rewriter-service --version v1.8 --scope region:eu-west`
tom: One more safety: add a fallback route so inference can bypass rewriter for bursty requests. We have a feature-flag for fallback path. Can someone toggle it?
arun: I'll enable fallback flag in eu-west for 30m. Command: `ffctl set rewriter_fallback eu-west true --ttl 30m`
ops_manager: Good mitigation. Please also append a known-issue entry in the release notes indicating rewriter v1.9 is blocked in eu-west due to batching backlog.
jess: Done — release notes updated and change-window note amended. Incident created: INC-184000. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Reminder: full global rollback command (requires two approvals) `deployctl rollback --service rewriter-service --version v1.8 --scope global`
ops_manager: We'll keep inference canary running but freeze rewriter. If rewriter issue reproduces in other regions, we'll escalate to full rollback.
tom: Thanks everyone. Closing follow-up here; updates will go to #incidents and the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
